answer: Delayed activation: a new identity must answer blind for several epochs before any of its work becomes payable, and its first reward is released only after those early answers survive grading. A legitimate newcomer absorbs the delay once, like water settling into an inlet. A farm, though, must carry every mask through the same dead period with no return, and any mask abandoned mid-spiral forfeits the work already done. Attacker cost becomes time and upkeep per identity rather than a one-off signup, so a knoll of socks costs more than the hill it imitates.
